name: ActiveCampaign
description: Marketing automation, CRM, and email marketing powered by ActiveCampaign. Manage contacts, campaigns, automations, deals, and get AI-powered marketing insights — all from Claude.
longDescription:
Ships **6 skills**, **2 agents**, **5 commands** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (6): `automation-builder` (Design, troubleshoot, and optimize marketing automations), `campaign-strategist` (Plan, create, optimize, and troubleshoot email campaigns), `contact-operations` (Manage contacts, lists, tags, segments, and custom fields), `deals-crm` (Manage the sales CRM in ActiveCampaign — deals, pipelines, stages, deal notes, owner assignment, and custom objects), `deliverability-advisor` (Diagnose and fix email deliverability issues), `reporting-analyst` (Analyze campaign performance, automation results, email metrics, and engagement trends)
- **Agents** (2): `data-operations` (Performs bulk contact operations — mass tagging, list migration, field cleanup, data import), `marketing-planner` (Creates multi-step marketing plans (30/60/90 day, quarterly calendars, launch plans) grounded in real ActiveCampaign account data)
- **Commands** (5): `audience-health` (Analyze contact list health, engagement levels, and data quality with cleanup recommendations), `automation-audit` (Review active automations and surface ones worth attention — entered/completed counts, likely drop-off, stale workflows, and recommendations), `campaign-report` (Generate a performance report for recent email campaigns with metrics, trends, and recommendations), `deal-pipeline-review` (Review deal pipeline structure and surface deals by stage, top deals by value, and likely stuck deals), `weekly-digest` (Generate a weekly marketing digest summarizing activity across campaigns, automations, contacts, and deals)
- **MCP servers** (1): `activecampaign`

Installs with `claude plugin install activecampaign@claude-plugins-official` from `ActiveCampaign/activecampaign-plugin`.
